name: jalyn-ecommerce-monorepo
description: Full-stack E-commerce Monorepo with Client Website, Express + MySQL + Multer Server, and CMS Admin Panel

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
